scope: blind static audit of frozen finalist systems measurement and execution ordering; no live GPU was queried; no service was polled; no checkpoint, log, result, or intermediate metric was accessed; no runtime environment was modified

execution_design.order: all six dense controls, control-only target lock, then all six candidates

potential_unmeasured_drivers: GPU boost clocks, power limit, and thermal throttling
host CPU, memory, storage, and OS load
driver or runtime state changes across multiple days

may_report: per-run analytic FLOPs/token on the frozen geometry
per-run CUDA-synchronized optimizer and steady-training seconds
per-run active, validation, checkpoint, and startup timing
order-stratified fixed-time and time-to-quality summaries as secondary descriptive evidence
the fixed control-first calendar order and all missing telemetry
may_not_report: causal architecture-only training speedup independent of calendar drift
production serving throughput, latency, resident capacity, or cost
systems evidence sufficient for architecture promotion or a broad efficiency claim

future_systems_protocol.activation: after the active fixed-sample language sequence and before any systems promotion claim
minimum_design: at least five thermally interleaved candidate/control blocks with randomized or balanced AB/BA order
record start, interval, and end temperature, board power, clocks, power limit, P-state, utilization, fan, and throttle reasons at monotonic timestamps
bind every sample to the exact GPU UUID, driver, CUDA, PyTorch, kernels, process, and workload interval
record five thermally matched idle blocks before and after for gross and incremental energy
record missing samples and bounded energy intervals without unbounded interpolation
isolate or record display, background GPU, CPU, memory, storage, and OS activity
persist a live-gate artifact for every block rather than only enforcing it transiently
freeze production serving batch, arrival-rate, context, output, precision, and runtime profiles separately
keep energy, time, memory, and dollars separate unless every monetary input is named and dated

decision.next_action: complete the language sequence unchanged; report its physical timing and memory descriptively with the calendar-block limitation, then run a separately frozen thermally interleaved telemetry-rich systems protocol before any causal efficiency or cost claim

non_claims: same GPU UUID and start temperature eliminate multi-day drift
paired seed/data cells make block-ordered timing causal
steady optimizer seconds are energy measurements
torch peak allocation measures persistent serving state or resident capacity
analytic FLOP reduction proves time, energy, dollar, or serving savings
this audit justifies adding telemetry to or reordering the active frozen sequence
